flags.message: Snapshot 2026-06-16.json is date-cut at the grant (ProceedingsandOrder ends 2026-06-15), but its attorney roster ('Other') still lists 28 amicus filers, the United States among them, who apparently filed merits-stage briefs after the cutoff. The date cut seems to cover the proceedings but not the party/attorney lists, so a grant-moment cell can see post-cutoff names. The roster shows names only, not sides, and was not used in the forecast. Forward cell, so there is no leakage breach, but the shared grant-moment baseline is not as narrow as the moment declares.
